diagnosisBy: orchestrator, measured on the live stand and in source

rootCauses.title: body has no background and no color rule anywhere

evidence.measured: computed styles on :8028 — html carries data-theme=sneakers data-mode=dark, --background #0a0a0a, --foreground #ededed, --fg-base #ededed (the bridge works), yet every h1/h2 probed returns color rgb(0,0,0) on bg rgb(10,10,10); document.body backgroundColor is rgba(0,0,0,0)
evidence.source: grep for a body{} rule across apps/storefront/src/styles/*.css returns zero matches; src/app/layout.tsx:33 renders <body> with no className

rootCauses.consequence: Any text that inherits its colour instead of naming a token falls back to the browser default black on the ink-black page. This is one CSS rule, not thirteen bugs.
rootCauses.fix: body { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground) } in globals.css, applied for every preset, plus a regression check that reads computed colour of a heading on four pages

rootCauses.title: 44 files paint with literal Tailwind colours instead of tokens

evidence.measured: grep of apps/storefront/src for bg-/text-/border-/ring-/fill-/stroke-/from-/to-/via- against white|black|neutral-N|gray-N|grey-N|zinc-N|slate-N|stone-N returns 44 FILES and 176 occurrences. The narrower first count (42 files) omitted slate and stone and the non-background properties. Top: bg-gray-100 x53, bg-gray-200 x21, bg-white x18, text-white x10, bg-black x9, text-zinc-600 x7, border-gray-200 x7

byArea.modules/shipping: 1 file, 18 occurrences — free-shipping-price-nudge, missed by the first pass

rootCauses.consequence: These surfaces stay white or light grey under every theme preset. They are invisible to the theme bridge by construction.
rootCauses.fix: Replace literal colours with canon tokens or ui-* tokens, file by file, with a lint rule that fails the build on a new literal colour class outside an allow-list

rootCauses.title: outline-none without a themed focus ring

evidence.measured: grep of src: outline-none x18 against focus-visible:ring-* x4 total. cart-item-select/index.tsx:55 carries `focus:border-gray-700 outline-none`
evidence.note: themes.css defines --ring per preset (sneakers dark #d6ff3b, light #4c6600), so a token exists and is unused

rootCauses.consequence: Keyboard and click focus falls back to the browser default blue, which belongs to no palette. Visible in the size and colourway dropdowns.
rootCauses.fix: Every interactive element that clears the outline must set focus-visible:ring-2 ring-[var(--ring)]; audit all 18 outline-none sites

rootCauses.title: Tailwind is configured for darkMode class while the theme switches on data-mode, so every dark: utility would be dead CSS

evidence.measured: apps/storefront/tailwind.config.js:4 is darkMode: "class"; grep finds ZERO elements carrying a `dark` class and ZERO dark: utilities in src; themes.css switches on data-mode with 9 selectors
evidence.reportedEarlier: the S1b agent wrote this up at artifacts/docs/2026-09-07-s1b-theme-bridge-report.md:464 and the S1 gate had no slot that would accept it
evidence.foundBy: retro-brief agent, verified by the orchestrator

rootCauses.consequence: This is a trap for the repaint, not a defect on screen today. Any engineer fixing class B who reaches for dark:bg-... writes CSS that never applies, because nothing sets the class the config listens for. The repaint must use tokens that resolve per data-mode, never dark: utilities — or the config must be switched to selector mode on [data-mode=dark] first.
rootCauses.fix: Decide one of the two and write it into the brief: either the repaint never uses dark: utilities, or tailwind.config.js switches to darkMode: ["selector", "[data-mode=dark]"] and the change is proved by a utility that actually applies

processFailures.title: No stage owned repainting the existing storefront
processFailures.detail: S1b's zone was styles/lib/theme/build script; S1c's zone was the new profile blocks plus the promo banner and the thumbnail aspect. nav, footer, cart-dropdown, side-menu, checkout, skeletons, divider and the account area were in nobody's file set. The brief created the gap, the agents did not.
processFailures.carryTo: wave 2 brief must name a repaint stage with the whole component surface as its zone

processFailures.title: The pixel gate proved the opposite of what was needed
processFailures.detail: T0h.5 compared the storefront before the bridge against the storefront with medusa/light active and demanded a difference under 0.1 percent. That is a regression proof — it certifies the theme changes nothing. Nothing in the programme measured that the sneakers preset actually reaches every surface.
processFailures.carryTo: wave 2 needs a coverage gate: computed colour of a sampled element on every route must equal a token of the active preset

processFailures.title: The creative director's final integrity check was never run
processFailures.detail: Programme section 6 assigns a final check over the contact sheet and screenshots to the creative director. The orchestrator did not run it, so the first human to see the rendered store was Ivan.
processFailures.carryTo: the visual gate is a blocking stage with a named owner, not a closing courtesy

processFailures.title: The orchestrator fix of a cross-zone blocker became the next blocker, and its own record called it a success
processFailures.detail: S1b was blocked by 11 top-level :global(html[...]) rules in a *.module.css compiled in PURE mode. The orchestrator split the global half into a plain stylesheet image-frame.globals.css but KEPT the :global() wrapper; a plain stylesheet has no CSS-modules compiler, so Turbopack rejected the file outright and the routes fell over again. S1c fixed it and records so in its own report at lines 271-276. The orchestrator entry in .ai/progress.md reads: zero :global left in the module, :8033/en -> 200 — true about the module, silent about the wrapper it had just carried into a new file. Two documents about one fix, and the third state exists in neither.
processFailures.measuredBy: retro-execution agent; confirmed by the orchestrator against artifacts/docs/2026-09-07-s1c-profile-blocks-report.md lines 271-276 and .ai/progress.md
processFailures.carryTo: a cross-zone fix by the orchestrator is itself a change and must be verified by a build, not by the route that happened to recover; and the record of a fix states what was measured AFTER it on the artefact the fix PRODUCED, not on the one it left behind

processFailures.title: The requirement that would have prevented cause A existed on disk and was cut when the brief was carried over
processFailures.detail: The preceding brief docs/prompts/initial-prompt-2026-09-06-orchestrator-theme-presets-panel.md line 23 demanded three checks in T0h.5, the third of them verbatim: "...flips, and that `body` background follows." The store-profiles brief line 29 kept only the pixel half of T0h.5 and dropped the body clause. Cause A is therefore not an oversight of thought — it is a loss in transcription. The same line 14 copied three counters from the predecessor and dropped the fourth fact standing beside them, that the code has zero dark: utilities, which is cause D.
processFailures.measuredBy: retro-brief agent; both lines read and confirmed by the orchestrator
processFailures.carryTo: when a brief is derived from an earlier brief, the derivation is a DIFF that is reviewed clause by clause, and every dropped clause is dropped on purpose with a reason written next to it

processFailures.title: Zones covered 20 files out of 302, and two parenthetical narrowings made the hole
processFailures.detail: A find across every declared zone of S1b and S1c covers 20 files of the 302 in the storefront source. Two qualifiers did the damage: `app/layout.tsx` head only fenced off line 33 where <body> stands, and `modules/products/components/thumbnail` for the aspect only admitted a component while explicitly excluding its colour. promo-banner was 1 of 11 siblings in modules/layout/components; cart-dropdown, side-menu, nav and footer belonged to nobody. In a 92-line brief the words footer, nav, skeleton, account, drawer and side-menu appear ZERO times, header appears once as headers(), and body appears once as --font-body — while line 70 states Ivan's acceptance as the palette being one and the same on home, listing, product and cart.
processFailures.measuredBy: retro-brief agent; word counts and the zone find re-run by the orchestrator
processFailures.carryTo: the stage zones of a wave must be proved to COVER the source tree: a script sums the declared zones and reports the uncovered files, and a brief whose acceptance names a surface must have a stage that owns it
